検.meaning: A park ranger climbs a <part>tree</part> above the <part>campsite</part> with binoculars and peers into every tent: are the fires out, the bins shut, the marshmallows shared fairly? She writes a score for each. Every camper dreads her <kanji>examination</kanji>.
検.on: Even the dogs' <sound>ken</sound>nel gets a mark out of ten.
検.kun: Peeking from behind a leafy <sound>shi</sound>eld, she cheers '<sound>Rah</sound>!' at the tidiest tent.

歌.meaning: A frog starts croaking on stage and the audience lets out a big <part>yawn</part>. But he keeps going, louder and sweeter, until the judges nod their <part>approval</part> one by one and start swaying. By the end, everyone is humming along to his <kanji>song</kanji>.
歌.on: Even a <sound>ca</sound>rp leaps out of the pond to join the chorus.
歌.kun: Afterwards they all slurp <sound>u</sound>don and munch <sound>ta</sound>cos backstage.

丸.meaning: A baker drops a single <part>dot</part> of dough and kicks it <part>nine</part> times across the kitchen floor. Each kick rolls it bigger and smoother, until it bounces like a ball. Now it's perfectly <kanji>round</kanji>.
丸.on: The floor is coated in sticky <sound>gun</sound>k from all that kicking.
丸.kun: '<sound>Ma</sound>, look!' The baker's son sets a <sound>ru</sound>by on top like a cherry.

勢.meaning: A tiny <part>gardener</part> drinks a whole watering can of tonic and swells up with <part>muscle</part>. He yanks out a tree stump, flings the shed over the hedge and pushes back a herd of charging goats. He alone is a match for an army's <kanji>forces</kanji>.
勢.on: For his next trick, he lifts the bank's steel <sound>sa</sound>fe over his head.
勢.kun: '<sound>Ea</sound>sy!' squeaks a <sound>ki</sound>wi bird on the fence. '<sound>Oh</sound>, look at him go!'

識.meaning: In a noisy hall, a hundred people give a <part>speech</part> at once while someone bashes a <part>war gong</part>. Only one old owl can pick out each voice: who's lying, who's joking, who's telling the truth. She has a gift: she can <kanji>discern</kanji>.
識.on: <sound>She</sound> locks the liars' notes away with a golden <sound>key</sound>.
識.kun: Then she peeks out from behind her <sound>shi</sound>eld: she knows exactly who did it.

笑.meaning: A man in a <part>tilted hat</part> walks through a grove of <part>bamboo</part>, and the stalks tickle his ears, his nose and his ribs. He tries to stay serious, but his hat slips further and he doubles over. He can't help it: he has to <kanji>laugh</kanji>.
笑.on: It's the funniest <sound>show</sound> in the woods; even the birds buy tickets.
笑.kun: He laughs so hard he drops his <sound>wa</sound>sabi into his <sound>ra</sound>men.

個.meaning: Every guest at the party hangs a coat on one long <part>coat hook</part>, then presses a thumb into soft clay and lets it <part>harden</part> into a little name badge. No two thumbprints are the same. Each badge belongs to one <kanji>individual</kanji>.
個.on: Even the <sound>ko</sound>ala gets its own badge, with a fluffy ear print.
